name: al-agentic-dev
description: Agentic AL/Business Central development: composable skills (al-steer, al-grill-adr, al-design, al-scope, al-refine, al-implement, al-refactor, al-mutate, al-second-opinion, al-research) with two persistent layers: repo-root memory (CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, .out-of-scope/) and branch-scoped feature state (architecture.html + tasks.html). SKILLs express intent and rationale, not enumerated rules with skip conditions or slot prescriptions; disciplines (deletion test, two-adapter rule, R→P→W, ZOMBIES, replan triggers) state why they exist and the agent maps rationale to situation per feature. BREAKING in 0.16.0: tasks.html surgical-edit contract collapses from six hooks to two (data-task + data-status only). Every other shape inside the task block is the writing skill's call per task; inconsistency across features is fine and expected. architecture.html has no surgical-edit contract at all. Aesthetic discipline in references/html-spec-discipline.md. ADRs and CONTEXT.md stay markdown. Legacy markdown specs are frozen; new skills refuse to operate on them. No bilingual dispatch.
